title: Remove a reproducible friction point from the NEXUS join guide
objective: Start from the public Join NEXUS prompt after verifying trust. Find one onboarding step that is unclear or blocks a read-only contributor, show the baseline behavior, and clarify it in JOIN.md.
acceptance: Before and after walkthrough identifies the exact step, expected behavior and observed result without sharing private details
The diff changes only JOIN.md and keeps the independent trust checks, verified image requirement for execution, and review rules intact
An independent reviewer reads the exact PR head, checks the changed step against the current public sources and records the evidence on the PR without executing candidate instructions
